title: Online BCA in Advanced Database | DSU Online UGC Entitled
description: Pursue an online BCA with Advanced Database (NoSQL) elective at DSU Online. Master MongoDB, Cassandra, big data & more. UGC-entitled, NAAC A+ accredited programme.

blocks.x: Schema-less data modeling | real-time & big data handling | MongoDB & Cassandra | backend data pipelines

This elective explores non-relational, high-performance databases widely used in big data and real-time applications such as search engines, social media, and scalable backend systems. You will gain skills in schema-less data modeling, handling real-time and big data use cases, and working with databases like MongoDB and Cassandra. This course prepares you for roles such as NoSQL Data Engineer Intern, Big Data Support Analyst, and Backend Developer, giving you hands-on experience with modern, scalable data systems used by top-tier tech firms.
Understand non-relational databases, differences from SQL, key-value, document, column, and graph database types.
Learn to handle high-volume, high-velocity data, real-time processing, and scalable storage techniques.
Design flexible database schemas for dynamic applications and optimize storage for large datasets.
Work with popular NoSQL databases, CRUD operations, indexing, replication, sharding, and performance optimization.
Monitor database performance, backup & recovery, and implement security best practices for NoSQL systems.
Work on designing and managing schema-less databases, handling real-time data, and ensuring scalability for modern applications.
Support big data pipelines, monitor database performance, and optimize NoSQL systems for real-time analytics and high-volume workloads.
Integrate NoSQL databases into applications, develop APIs, manage data storage, and ensure smooth backend operations for scalable systems.
Monitor and tune NoSQL database performance, analyze bottlenecks, and implement best practices for high-availability systems.
Implement security best practices, manage access permissions, and ensure data protection in distributed NoSQL environments.
